messages:
tara: Quick triage: we have two candidate priorities for the 3-day mini: (1) urgent embed reliability fix affecting paying tenants, or (2) "delight" UX polish for the onboarding modal that could lift activation. Need a decision to update the sprint board.

ben: Reliability. Support has 6 open tickets and a spike in errors this morning.

min: +1 for reliability. I reproduced in staging and can trigger the failure with a malformed payload. Repro steps take ~15m.

oscar: If we go reliability-first, let's scope to a patch that ships in one deploy window. Don't turn this into a refactor.

tara: Agreed. We want an MR with minimal surface area, defensive checks, tests, canary. UX polish moves to wave-sprint B.

jali: Data context: onboarding polish lifts new-user activation by ~2.9% but only impacts first-time signups. Embed bug impacts existing customers and increases support SLA breaches. Prioritize bug.

ben: Proposed plan: 1) triage & add failing unit test (same day); 2) implement guard + retry; 3) add integration test that simulates malformed payload; 4) canary to 5% traffic for 6 hours. Owner: Ben.

min: I can pair on integration test tomorrow AM. CI sometimes flakes on the test cluster; add 0.5 days buffer.

oscar: Ops ask: set canary SLIs for embed_error_rate and embed_p99_latency, and create a dashboard card for canary cohort. SRE please.

sre-bot: Canary dashboard card "canary/embed-cohort-1787659997" created. Alerts set: embed_error_rate > 0.5% and embed_p99_latency > 900ms.

jali: Also recommend we tag the UX polish ticket as "deferred: wave-b" and add acceptance criteria so it can be picked up without re-spec. I'll do that after this thread.

ben: I'll open branch hotfix/embed-robust-guard and push a WIP PR by EOD. Local repro command for devs:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embed -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV' -d '{"input":"\u0000malformed\u0000"}'
```

min: I'll add the integration test that hits the same sequence and validate retry logic.

oscar: Customer comms: I'll draft a short status note to affected tenants once canary is green. Keep it concise: timeline + what we changed + contact.

tara: Decision: reliability-first for this mini-sprint. Action owners recap: Ben -> PR + unit test + patch; Min -> integration tests + buffer; Jali -> move UX polish to wave-sprint B + ACs; Oscar -> customer comms; SRE -> monitor canary. Target: canary verification within 24h of deploy. Any objections?

min: No objections.

ben: No objections. PR opened WIP and assigned reviewers @min @tara.

sre-bot: Canary deploy queued for commit 9f3c2a on cluster shore-2.

oscar: I'll wait for canary green before sending customer note.

tara: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if canary shows anything. If green, we merge and close the mini-sprint. If rollback, capture a 1-pager postmortem and re-evaluate polish timing.
